title: Customer Embarkation Sync — field notes and action log
content:
Meeting: Solutions + ProServices weekly sync (ad-hoc extension)
Date: 2028-12-06 (notes compiled 12/08)
Attendees: Priya S., Liam C., Amara P., Diego R., Sofia N., Thomas (customer ENG: Velotech)
Length: 45m + 15m deep-dive with Velotech

Purpose: quick triage of active on-ramps, surface immediate risks for next 2 sprints, lock owners for unblock tasks. Emphasis on runtime incidents, VPC connectivity, and roll-forward plan for quantized model discrepancy observed in staging.

Top takeaways (TL;DR):
- Velotech: major near-term blocker is KV cache warmup behavior causing ~3x tail latency for long multi-turn sessions. SRE + runtime to prototype a prefix-warmup shim by EOW.
- Hearthbank: VPC peering intermittent (route flaps during backend autoscaler events). Infra to force static route test and engage cloud rep if flaps continue.
- Greenlane AI: model mismatch when pinned to v2.3-q8 (generation truncation). Research suspects tokenization mismatch between onboarding script and deployed model binary.
- Canary rollout: decided to hold on canary for all customers using v2.3-q8 until Greenlane fix validated (risk of partial degradation).

Notes by customer

1) Velotech (priority: high)
- Context: production-like load replay from their integration harness shows consistent tail spikes on long-running chat sessions (> 6 turns). Spikes correlate with KV cache cold starts for some GPUs (observed on pod restarts and scale-out).
- Observed metrics: p95 token latency jumps from 85ms -> 270ms for a 512-token continuation; CPU on host stays low, GPU util ~22% at spike onset.
- Hypothesis: cache miss + serialization step rehydration creates a synchronous blocking path in the runtime; continuous-batching window collapsed unexpectedly when pod enters warmup state.
- Temporary mitigation: reduce max-batch-window to 8ms for Velotech's dedicated pool (Amara will apply patch to fleet config and monitor).
- Action items: 
  - Diego -> prototype a lightweight prefix-warmup shim that pre-populates KV cache for pinned session hashes (due 2028-12-13).
  - Liam -> add tracing span around KV restore path (PR reference: serving-runtime#1998) and push to staging for Velotech replay (due 2028-12-09).
  - Priya -> coordinate extended performance window with Velotech (test slot Dec 15, 1–3pm PST).
- Notes to self: confirm whether warmup behavior varies by quantization profile (q4 vs q8) — tag runtime-research.

2) Hearthbank (priority: medium)
- Context: customer using Redwood Dedicated with private VPC peering. Route flaps observed during cluster autoscaler activity; traffic temporarily falls back to regional hosted pool and customers see 502s for ~20–60s.
- Debug info: cloud provider logs show BGP session reset correlated with scale-out events; tickets raised with cloud rep.
- Quick tests: created a static route in a lab VPC and simulated scale events — static route prevented flap in 3/3 runs.
- Action items:
  - Amara -> push static-route test config to Hearthbank staging (due 2028-12-10) and document manual rollback steps.
  - Diego -> instrument autoscaler to emit pre-scale webhook for tenant notification (INTG-8423 backlog item) — prototype by 2028-12-20.
  - Priya -> open escalation with cloud rep; include pcap and BGP reset timestamps (done 12/06, case# 224181).
- Risk: moderate. If unresolved, plan B = schedule maintenance window to switch to tunnel-based peering for Hearthbank.

3) Greenlane AI (priority: high)
- Symptom: when pinned to model v2.3-q8, some prompts return truncated completions missing last clause; reproduction rate ~12% on their eval set. Notably, v2.3-fp16 does not show the issue.
- Investigation notes: tokenization end offsets differ between onboarding tokenizer (python tokenizer v1.12) and C++ runtime tokenizer. Suspect whitespace-handling corner-case and post-processing trimming logic.
- Temporary mitigation: roll back Greenlane to v2.3-fp16 for canary traffic.
- Action items:
  - Sofia -> run a token-level diff harness between python and runtime tokenizers across Greenlane's failing prompts (due 2028-12-09).
  - Runtime-research (assign: Jay) -> reproduce within debug build and add unit test for the trimming edge-case (due 2028-12-12).
  - Priya -> pause any canary promotions for q8 family until fix validated and regression tests pass.
- Note: communicate rollback plan to Greenlane product lead — they prefer q8 for cost but accept temporary fp16 rollback if ETA < 1 week.

Cross-cutting engineering items
- Canary gating: new rule agreed — if any customer in the onramp cohort has an unresolved Q8 regression, hold cross-customer q8 canary promotion. Documented in CONFLUENCE-ONRAMP-712.
- Rollout policy tweak: add automatic reversion on 5xx spike (>0.5% increase over baseline) within 30m of a canary step. Priya to draft policy text by 12/11.
- Observability: add a lightweight KV-cache-health metric (cache-warm hits, miss-rate, restore-latency) to the per-model dashboard. Liam to scope metrics and update dashboard template (due 12/14).

Operational & support notes
- Escalations: Hearthbank cloud case open; tracking in INTG-8423. Velotech ticket to SRE created for tail-latency (SRE-1256). Greenlane regression added to runtime-research backlog.
- Customer comms: Priya to send a summary email to the three POCs with planned mitigations and expected timelines (send by EOD 12/08). Keep messaging factual and time-boxed.
- Scheduled test windows: Velotech perf run on 12/15; Hearthbank staging static-route verification on 12/11; Greenlane q8 unit/regression validation 12/12–12/13.

Open questions / parking lot
- Do we want a per-tenant warmup profile that proactively keeps a tiny cache population based on last-N sessions? Pros: reduced tail; Cons: memory footprint + extra ops. (Parked for infra architecture sync).
- Should we make q8 family an opt-in experimental flag per tenant until we have token-level parity tests? (Priya: likely yes for high-risk customers).
- Who owns the indefinite hunt when a tail-latency signal is noisy across many tenants? Proposal: SRE owns detection + mitigation loop; solutions owns customer-facing diagnostics.

Action item summary (owner -> task -> due)
- Diego -> KV prefix warmup shim prototype -> 2028-12-13
- Liam -> KV restore tracing span + staging PR -> 2028-12-09
- Amara -> apply reduced max-batch-window for Velotech and push Hearthbank static-route to staging -> 2028-12-10
- Sofia -> tokenizer diff harness for Greenlane prompts -> 2028-12-09
- Jay (runtime-research) -> unit test + debug build reproducer for q8 trimming -> 2028-12-12
- Priya -> customer summary email + policy draft for canary reversion -> 2028-12-08 and 2028-12-11
- Liam -> KV-cache metrics + dashboard template update -> 2028-12-14

Misc notes / freeform
- Diego: remember to run the shim in a sandbox before any Dedicated deploy; we saw a side-effect last quarter where shim bumped ephemeral memory usage on a 48GB GPU node.
- Amara: keep a short rollback playbook in the Hearthbank staging folder (link to be added).
- Quick wins: adding a pre-scale webhook for autoscaler should reduce perceived 502 windows for customers while infra pursues long-term fixes.

Meeting artifacts to attach later: session replay clips (Velotech replay), pcap of BGP reset (Hearthbank), token diff dumps (Greenlane).

Next sync: weekly on Tues 09:30 PST; if any of the EOW owners hit blockers we escalate to war room.

-- end of notes --

Notes style: intentionally conversational / rough — treat as working doc. Update as owners close items and ping me (Priya) for refresh.
